achievables.scientificObjective: Verify the exact WP007K parent, current repository state, runtime, resources and sealed reserves.
achievables.practicalObjective: Create a clean isolated WP007L worktree without touching unrelated user work.
achievables.hypothesis: The frozen WP007K environment and controls can be reused safely.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Exact parent/head, PR state, current origin, worktree, runtime and disk/RAM records.
achievables.expectedResult: Clean branch from 8a5188c1 with SAFE-A and reserves intact.
achievables.experiment: Fetch, inspect PRs, worktrees, caches and resource state.
achievables.independentValidation: GitHub metadata and local Git ancestry cross-check.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Current customer traffic and future device populations remain outside this bounded audit.

achievables.scientificObjective: Resolve the WP007K E1 encoder-held-out metric discrepancy.
achievables.practicalObjective: Identify the canonical artifact for future research and preserve historical files unchanged.
achievables.hypothesis: Raw v2 records and explicit encoder grouping can resolve the discrepancy.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Model hashes, thresholds, record-ID hashes, score-row hashes and independent aggregates.
achievables.expectedResult: E1 canonical held-out Sharp recall is 73/700; E2 held-out Pillow recall is 166/700.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Raw paths disagree or model/threshold association cannot be reproduced.
achievables.experiment: Recompute affected slices by explicit encoder and verify hashes.
achievables.independentValidation: Compare compact, by-encoder and v2 raw-record paths.
achievables.rightsStatus: Inherited research artifacts; no new media.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The stale compact metric's original association bug is not reconstructed beyond the observed mismatch.

achievables.scientificObjective: Find mature implementations for JPEG structure, grid/resampling, sensor, metadata and provenance evidence.
achievables.practicalObjective: Decide which tools can be executed, validated, adopted, or independently reimplemented.
achievables.hypothesis: A modular toolchain exists, but licensing and maturity will differ sharply.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Pinned commits, implemented capabilities, scientific references, local test result, runtime and license.
achievables.expectedResult: A non-hype tool landscape with explicit decision states.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Capability-specific replacements where permissive infrastructure is insufficient.
achievables.datasetRole: Tool fixtures and approved project media.
achievables.experiment: GitHub/source reconnaissance followed by local execution of feasible candidates.
achievables.independentValidation: Official source, license file, pinned revision and known-answer fixture.
achievables.rightsStatus: Per-tool audit required; GPL/AGPL firewall mandatory.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Pinned-source behavior may change in future releases; no floating dependency is used.

achievables.scientificObjective: Separate research-oracle value from commercial-path rights.
achievables.practicalObjective: Prevent GPL/AGPL and unclear dependency contamination of Lythaus-owned modules.
achievables.hypothesis: Permissive tools can cover some runtime needs, while copyleft tools remain reference-only.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Exact license/NOTICE/dependency records and production recommendation per tool.
achievables.falsificationCondition: A required capability has no rights-compliant path.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Small independent parsers/measurements with clean provenance.
achievables.experiment: Audit repository and bundled dependency licenses.
achievables.independentValidation: Official LICENSE/NOTICE and pinned source comparison.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Patent and bundled-component questions remain owner/legal review items; no production dependency is authorized.

achievables.scientificObjective: Determine the available camera model/device families and independent rights-clean confirmation capacity.
achievables.practicalObjective: Avoid opening sealed EF2 reserves and prevent model/device leakage.
achievables.hypothesis: Existing approved media supports at least bounded profile and transformation experiments.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Source/device/model counts, rights, native certainty, reserve status and privacy-safe identifiers.
achievables.expectedResult: A clear development/confirmation/reserve inventory or an explicit independent-data blocker.
achievables.falsificationCondition: No independent rights-clean camera sources exist.
achievables.experiment: Inventory existing local manifests/caches without opening sealed reserves.
achievables.independentValidation: Hashes, source-family grouping and metadata-oracle cross-check.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Historical confirmation is not fresh physical-device ground truth; that limitation blocks broad native qualification.

achievables.scientificObjective: Create source-linked ground-truth native, recompressed, resampled, cropped, metadata and PNG descendants.
achievables.practicalObjective: Make every history claim auditable against known operations rather than guessed from bytes.
achievables.hypothesis: A bounded matrix can expose useful signals and their failure modes.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Parent IDs, operation chains, encoders, DQT, crop offsets, output hashes and privacy-safe metadata.
achievables.expectedResult: No descendant crosses source-family roles; known history is retained.
achievables.datasetRole: Development and confirmation by source family.
achievables.experiment: Run predeclared transformation matrix on eligible camera media.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Controlled descendants cannot represent every real-world edit chain; final-byte history remains unknowable without provenance.

achievables.scientificObjective: Qualify measurable JPEG marker, DQT/DHT, sampling, coefficient and encoder-profile evidence.
achievables.practicalObjective: Build or adopt narrow, auditable codec instruments without assigning origin truth.
achievables.hypothesis: Bitstream and coefficient facts are reproducible but profile-only evidence is spoofable.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Known-answer parser results, cross-tool comparisons, per-device/model stability and spoof outcomes.
achievables.expectedResult: Separate stable context from unsafe authenticity inference.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Parser disagreement cannot be resolved or measurements are nondeterministic.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: JPEG Bitstream Fingerprinter and Coefficient Analyzer.
achievables.datasetRole: Native originals, controlled descendants and synthetic profile spoofs.
achievables.independentValidation: Two parser paths and known byte fixtures.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Attackers can reproduce static codec profiles; measurements remain context-only.

achievables.scientificObjective: Measure aligned/non-aligned crop, double JPEG, JPEG ghost and resampling evidence.
achievables.practicalObjective: Determine whether transformations can be downgraded with useful sensitivity and bounded false downgrade.
achievables.hypothesis: Grid and double-quantization evidence can detect some controlled history but will not prove complete history.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Per-operation source-level metrics, confidence/reason codes and oracle disagreement.
achievables.expectedResult: Qualified, limited or rejected sub-tools, not a single original score.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Methods fail known-answer transforms or overreject native originals.
achievables.datasetRole: Controlled descendants and independent confirmation families.
achievables.experiment: Run oracle and Lythaus measurements across transformation matrix.
achievables.independentValidation: Known operation labels, cross-implementation checks and spoof tests.
achievables.rightsStatus: ZERO/Sherloq remain oracle-only unless independently reimplemented.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Unknown real-world history may remain unobservable; ZERO was a limited one-pair oracle cross-check.

achievables.scientificObjective: Measure metadata graph and embedded-thumbnail consistency as acquisition/history context.
achievables.practicalObjective: Detect contradictions without treating metadata presence or absence as origin truth.
achievables.hypothesis: Cross-field and thumbnail contradictions expose some editing/re-export paths.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Parser/oracle comparison, privacy redaction, controlled edit outcomes and spoof resistance.
achievables.expectedResult: Contextual consistency signals with explicit missing/unknown states.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Signals are trivial to copy or too unstable to interpret.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Metadata Consistency Graph and Thumbnail Analyzer.
achievables.datasetRole: Native camera media, edited descendants and synthetic profile spoofs.
achievables.experiment: Compare fields, previews, dimensions, timestamps and marker/profile relationships.
achievables.independentValidation: ExifTool cross-check and known edit fixtures.
achievables.rightsStatus: Privacy review required; no raw serial/GPS in Git.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Copied metadata can mimic native profiles; visual thumbnail correspondence remains unqualified.

achievables.scientificObjective: Assess PRNU/PNU, CFA/demosaicing and hot/dead pixel evidence as EF2 enhancements.
achievables.practicalObjective: Determine whether device-level acquisition evidence is feasible without persistent identity storage.
achievables.hypothesis: PRNU may require enrolled same-device references and degrade under recompression; CFA may be context-only.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Same-device vs other-device distributions, reference count, compression effects, CPU cost and privacy status.
achievables.expectedResult: Promising, limited or impractical; no synthetic inference from mismatch.
achievables.falsificationCondition: No device separation or signal is destroyed by ordinary processing.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Privacy-safe residual/PRNU prototype only if data supports it.
achievables.datasetRole: Known physical-device groups; sealed future devices excluded.
achievables.experiment: Run only if same-device references are sufficient; otherwise complete feasibility blocker.
achievables.independentValidation: MIT/reference implementation or known fixture and device-held-out checks.
achievables.rightsStatus: Reference code may be MIT; MATLAB runtime not a production dependency.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Modern ISP, denoising, JPEG, missing RAW references and privacy constraints prevent product qualification on this cohort.

achievables.scientificObjective: Assess official C2PA validation as a separate provenance evidence family.
achievables.practicalObjective: Reuse mature standards rather than inventing cryptographic provenance.
achievables.hypothesis: Valid/invalid manifests and hard bindings are useful EF1 evidence, while absence is neutral.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Pinned official tool, valid/invalid fixtures, signature/hard-binding results and current EF1 overlap.
achievables.expectedResult: Adoption recommendation or explicit no-change result.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Runtime/rights prevent safe validation or current EF1 already covers it.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Thin wrapper/contract only, not custom cryptography.
achievables.experiment: Audit and execute official validation fixtures where available.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Signed-fixture/Cargo execution was exhausted locally; official source/rights audit is complete, while trust policy remains owner/legal work.

achievables.scientificObjective: Separate camera model/pipeline stability from physical-device stability.
achievables.practicalObjective: Determine what a native-looking profile can and cannot establish.
achievables.hypothesis: DQT/markers identify pipeline/model more readily than physical device; PRNU is the device-level candidate.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Intra-device, inter-device same-model and inter-model distributions plus spoofability.
achievables.expectedResult: Profile context is useful but not sufficient for supported status unless corroborated.
achievables.falsificationCondition: No stable profile features or profile-only spoof passes too easily.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Camera Profile Feature Definition and consistency report.
achievables.datasetRole: Development/confirmation device families; no sealed reserves.
achievables.experiment: Compute feature variability by model/device/capture mode.
achievables.independentValidation: Separate source manifest and oracle parser.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Historical confirmation lacks fresh physical-device ground truth, so profile stability cannot qualify acquisition.

achievables.scientificObjective: Test whether synthetic/transformed images can mimic native camera profiles and whether that destroys SAFE-A.
achievables.practicalObjective: Prevent profile-only evidence from earning supported status.
achievables.hypothesis: Static DQT/EXIF/marker profiles are easy to imitate; SAFE-A behavior may also be changed by the mimic.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Controlled spoof procedures, tool outputs, SAFE-A scores, EF2 separation and acceptance/rejection counts.
achievables.expectedResult: Spoof-resistant combination or explicit profile-only rejection.
achievables.falsificationCondition: A synthetic profile spoof passes the proposed eligibility rule.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Sanitized spoof harness and policy test.
achievables.datasetRole: Research-only synthetic and native profile fixtures.
achievables.experiment: Copy DQT/EXIF/markers/dimensions/ICC/thumbnail where feasible; score without public bypass guidance.
achievables.independentValidation: Second parser and SAFE-A frozen path.
achievables.rightsStatus: Use approved media; no deceptive public distribution.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: The bounded harness is not an exhaustive adversarial model; it already falsifies profile-only support.

achievables.scientificObjective: Determine whether CES-E can create a meaningful evidence-grade/native-camera route.
achievables.practicalObjective: Quantify bounded pass/limited/unsupported rates without production enforcement.
achievables.hypothesis: A multi-axis route may be useful, while profile-only supported status is unsafe.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Sensitivity, false downgrade, unknown, native acceptance, recompression downgrade and spoof acceptance metrics.
achievables.expectedResult: Qualified research-only route, limited route, or insufficient-data conclusion.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Native originals rejected overwhelmingly or synthetic spoof passes.
achievables.lythausOwnedCandidate: Evidence router contract with separate axes.
achievables.datasetRole: Bounded research estimate, not customer traffic.
achievables.experiment: Apply frozen measurements after tool/feature confirmation; no production change.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Customer traffic composition and adversarial distribution are unknown; no customer acceptance rate is claimed.

achievables.scientificObjective: Choose third-party runtime, validation-only, Lythaus-owned and rejected modules.
achievables.practicalObjective: Keep the future toolchain CPU-feasible, small, reproducible and portable.
achievables.hypothesis: A narrow modular toolkit can outperform a monolithic detector for applicability routing.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Runtime p50/p95/max, peak RAM, dependency size, hashes, ownership and maintenance decision.
achievables.falsificationCondition: No rights/CPU/auditability path meets project constraints.
achievables.datasetRole: Tool fixtures and bounded project media.
achievables.independentValidation: Second process/repeated timing and artifact hashes.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Future Cloudflare portability is not proven locally; no production path is authorized.

achievables.scientificObjective: Preserve EF1/EF2/SAFE/GPT-OSS/Safety/Moondream role boundaries and metadata privacy.
achievables.practicalObjective: Prevent research artifacts from leaking GPS/serials and prevent context from becoming origin truth.
achievables.hypothesis: Structured independent evidence contracts can represent unknown/contradictory states safely.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Focused tests for privacy, role isolation, missingness and contradiction preservation.
achievables.falsificationCondition: A tool or contract silently emits authorship or mutates SAFE/EF2.
achievables.experiment: Add focused contract tests without production routing.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: Legal/privacy owner review remains external; artifacts contain no raw GPS, serial, owner or timestamp values.

achievables.scientificObjective: Preserve FLUX.2 and all future reserves while validating WP007L controls.
achievables.practicalObjective: Publish a reviewable unmerged PR with no production mutation.
achievables.hypothesis: WP007L can finish using existing approved media and bounded local tooling.
achievables.requiredEvidence: Zero-access assertion, focused/historical tests, JSON/syntax/privacy checks and PR metadata.
achievables.expectedResult: All achievable rows at 110% or a justified data/runtime blocker.
achievables.falsificationCondition: Sealed data access, production mutation or untracked rights violation.
achievables.experiment: Run full applicable validation and open unmerged PR.
achievables.remainingUncertainty: CI/reviewer feedback after publication remains outside the local completion audit.
